annotations.text:
WHAT SHIPS  ·  every artboard on this page titled CHOSEN. The two comparison sheets show rejected options beside the chosen one -- read their titles.

LESSON  ·  rail (rail green) / paper column / explainer (field green). Kept: colour fields, drop cap, crest, margin annotation. Cut: repp stripe, varsity numerals, ribbon, stamped seal.

CHECKPOINT  ·  C, the margin question, is CHOSEN. A paper card, B torn slip, D index card are rejected -- B stays with homework, D is parked.

CHECKPOINT AT 390px  ·  P1, the lead-in line, is CHOSEN. P2 tinted band and P3 rule-as-container are rejected.

MATERIALS  ·  paper column reads, photocopy sheet practises (homework + all three refresher grains), blue book examines. Blue book interior is on a 30px rhythm with type on the rules.

PARKED, NOT DISCARDED  ·  legal pad for v1.1 notes; index card unassigned; torn slip stays with homework.

Ivory, mahogany, brass, deep oxblood.

WHAT SHIPS  ·  the two artboards titled CHOSEN. Everything else on this page is the record of what they beat (Colin, 2026-09-11).

THE WORDMARK  ·  W3, stacked letterspaced caps. The 252px rail decided it: the name set as one line wraps there at any size large enough to read, and stacked it fits with 58px spare. The crest is 34px and two 15px lines are 34px, so mark and name are one object, with the course on its own line under a hairline. W1 rejected. The page-1 rails are drawn this way now, and <Wordmark/> is what the app renders.

THE MOTTO  ·  P2, engraved as its own line between brass rules, hanging off the mark rather than the headline. P1 put it on a band beneath the shield and the band did not read as a band at any size the page uses; it is rejected for now, and is the thing to revisit if the crest is ever punched up. No third Crest variant is built.

THE PAGE  ·  L2, the argument leads. The mark is the page's one object rather than a header.

THE GROUND  ·  a step below the reading ground: the front door is the one screen with no student inside it, and the step down is what says the course has not started. G1 paper made the door look like a lesson; G2 rail green cost the primary button a gold hairline it needs on neither light ground.

THE STEP IS NOT THE DESK  ·  G3 was drawn on --desk and judged invisible. 2.4% under --ground is plenty where the two touch (the blue book lying on the page) and nothing full-bleed, where no --ground sits beside it to be read against. The chosen page is on --door, oklch(0.915 0.016 95) -- its own value, because deepening the desk would change the exam screen to fix the landing page. --muted-ink holds 4.62:1 on it. The G3 artboard below is kept at the value that was judged, not corrected.

NO BAR, NO FOOTER  ·  both were drawn and both are cut. Every link they carried has another owner: the motto is in the hero, the 18+ attestation is on the registration form (D45), Install is a member route off the user menu, and Log in and Register are the hero's two buttons. Terms had no other owner on a public page, so it is the one quiet line at the foot. Spec 8.13.4 is rewritten to match.
